title: PMDD — the same week every month (DRSP · 2 cycles)
caption:
Same week every month, fine by day 2? That's not "just PMS." PMDD is diagnosed from 2 cycles of daily ratings (DRSP, Endicott 2006), not from memory. Save this for her. Which cycle day hits hardest?
www.aiforheratx.org
#pmdd #pmddawareness #cycletracking #womenshealth #hormonehealth #pmsrelief

scenes.text: One week a month I want to quit everything. Then my period starts and I'm *fine*.
Everyone told me it was just PMS. I was up googling whether I'm a bad person.
phrases: I googled: am I a bad person.
Then day 2 came and I was me again.

scenes.text: Her hormones were normal. Switch them off, add them back, and only the PMDD group crashes.
phrases: Researchers switched them off, then added them back.
Only the PMDD group crashed again.
So it's sensitivity to normal hormones, not broken ones.

scenes.text: Rate your 3 worst symptoms 0–3 tonight and write the cycle day beside them.
phrases: Rate your 3 worst symptoms 0–3. Add the cycle day.
Do that for two cycles and you have a record, not a memory.
ACOG also lists 1,200 mg/day calcium; WHO says 150 min/week of movement.
